Bumped (+1 extern ABI contract, 478->479) for the measured_boot_init pre-GUI-freeze pinpointing: crypto.ghl externs boot_mark (boot_timing.ghl) to paint debug-only sub-stage progress blocks (m0..m4) inside measured_boot_init so a real-HW wedge there is bisected to the exact SHA sub-step; the boot_mark calls are GRIT_BOOT_TRACE-gated (no-op in release) but the extern declaration is unconditional, adding one function->extern edge. Bumped (+1 extern ABI contract, 480->481): the measured_boot_init boot_mark extern (BootTrace m0..m4 pinpointing) was described in an earlier note but its count increment was never applied (a duplicate '479->480' note collided with the device-enum-join bump that actually consumed 480) - this corrects the count to include crypto.ghl's unconditional `extern boot_mark`.
